critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: PM, Backend Developer, and Frontend Developer must be dedicated full-time across all phases; UX Designer front-loaded to Phase 1-2; DevOps Engineer back-loaded to Phase 5.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment session completed and scope signed off
User personas and success metrics defined
E-signature vendor selected and legal review approved
Architecture and API integration plan approved

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and document scope sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Signed scope document with all stakeholders (HR, IT, CEO) confirming project goals, success metrics, and constraints.

tasks.name: Define user personas and success metrics for new hire and HR admin
tasks.definition_of_done: Documented personas (new hire, HR admin) with adoption targets and 80% pre-day-one completion metric baseline.

tasks.name: Evaluate and select e-signature service vendor with legal compliance review
tasks.definition_of_done: Vendor selected, contract signed, SOC 2 compliance confirmed, and form templates (I-9, W-4, direct deposit) validated.

tasks.name: Design system architecture and API integration plan for Workday and Azure AD
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram, API integration sequence diagrams, and data flow documentation approved by tech lead and IT Administrator.

tasks.name: Create detailed wireframes and user flows for onboarding portal UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Wireframes for all 6 main screens (checklist, document upload, team intro, account status, HR dashboard, audit logs) with user flow annotations.

tasks.name: Validate Workday API sandbox access and document integration requirements
tasks.definition_of_done: Workday sandbox credentials confirmed, API documentation reviewed, field mapping list created, and custom configuration scope determined.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: Authentication and core portal UI complete
Sprint 2: Onboarding checklist and document upload workflow complete
Sprint 3: Workday integration and data pre-population complete
Sprint 4: Azure AD provisioning integration complete
Sprint 5: E-signature integration and team introduction feature complete

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO authentication and session management
tasks.definition_of_done: New hire can log in via Azure AD SSO, session persists across portal pages, logout clears session, and audit log records authentication event.

tasks.name: Build portal UI shell with navigation, header, and responsive layout
tasks.definition_of_done: React component library with navigation, responsive grid layout, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) tested on mobile and desktop.

tasks.name: Implement onboarding checklist UI with task status tracking
tasks.definition_of_done: Checklist displays all 8 onboarding tasks with due dates, completion status, and progress bar; new hire can mark tasks complete.

tasks.name: Build document upload and e-signature integration with selected vendor
tasks.definition_of_done: New hire can upload I-9, W-4, direct deposit forms; e-signature service API called; signed documents stored with audit trail; SOC 2 compliance verified.

tasks.name: Implement Workday API integration for new hire data pre-population
tasks.definition_of_done: System fetches new hire name, email, department, manager from Workday; pre-populates onboarding form fields; error handling for API failures; tested with 10 sample records.

tasks.name: Build Azure AD account provisioning integration for email and SaaS tools
tasks.definition_of_done: System creates email account, Slack account, and configured SaaS tool accounts via Azure AD API; zero manual IT tickets; audit log records all provisioning actions.

tasks.name: Implement team introduction feature with member profiles and photos
tasks.definition_of_done: New hire views team member cards with photo, name, role, and bio; searchable by name or department; loads from HR database.

tasks.name: Build HR admin dashboard for onboarding progress monitoring
tasks.definition_of_done: HR admin views list of all new hires with task completion %, can filter by start date, export report; real-time updates.

tasks.name: Implement audit logging system for SOC 2 compliance
tasks.definition_of_done: All onboarding actions (login, document upload, task completion, account provisioning) logged with timestamp, user ID, action type, and result; immutable audit table.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with stakeholders and gather feedback
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo covers all 6 use cases; stakeholders confirm core features meet requirements; feedback logged and prioritized for Phase 3.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 6: Error handling and retry logic for all integrations complete
Sprint 7: Edge cases and data validation complete

tasks.name: Implement error handling and retry logic for Workday and Azure AD APIs
tasks.definition_of_done: API failures trigger exponential backoff retry; user sees clear error message; failed provisioning tasks queued for manual retry; tested with simulated API outages.

tasks.name: Add data validation and edge case handling for form submissions
tasks.definition_of_done: Form validates required fields, email format, phone format, SSN format; handles duplicate submissions; prevents form submission if required docs not signed.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and implement SOC 2 compliance controls
tasks.definition_of_done: Security audit completed; OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities addressed; data encryption at rest and in transit verified; audit logs immutable and tamper-evident.

tasks.name: Execute end-to-end integration testing across all systems
tasks.definition_of_done: Test scenarios cover: new hire login → checklist → document upload → e-signature → account provisioning → HR dashboard view; all 8 use cases tested; zero critical bugs.

tasks.name: Optimize database queries and implement caching for performance
tasks.definition_of_done: HR dashboard loads in < 2 seconds; checklist page loads in < 1 second; Redis caching implemented for team member profiles.

tasks.name: Build automated test suite for regression testing
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated tests cover happy path and error scenarios; 80% code coverage; tests run in CI/CD pipeline on every commit.

tasks.name: Create runbooks and troubleshooting guides for IT team
tasks.definition_of_done: Runbooks document: account provisioning failures, Workday sync issues, e-signature service outages, audit log queries; IT team trained and sign-off obtained.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with HR team and new hire representatives

tasks.name: Execute UAT with HR team and new hire representatives
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT script covers all 8 use cases; 5+ new hires and 3+ HR admins test portal; sign-off document confirms readiness for production.

tasks.name: Conduct accessibility audit and remediate WCAG 2.1 AA violations
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated accessibility scan (axe, WAVE) shows zero violations; keyboard navigation tested; screen reader tested; WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified.

tasks.name: Resolve all critical and high-priority bugs from UAT and testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All critical bugs (data loss, security, compliance) fixed and verified; high-priority bugs (workflow breaks, integration failures) fixed; regression testing passed.

tasks.name: Create user documentation and training materials for HR and new hires
tasks.definition_of_done: User guides for new hire onboarding flow; admin guide for HR dashboard; video tutorials (3-5 min each); FAQ document; training session conducted with HR team.

tasks.name: Prepare adoption and communication plan for launch
tasks.definition_of_done: Communication plan includes: email announcement, HR team briefing, new hire onboarding email, FAQ, support contact info; adoption metrics dashboard created.

tasks.name: Establish post-launch ownership and support model
tasks.definition_of_done: Named product owner assigned; support escalation path defined; SLA for bug fixes and feature requests documented; handoff meeting completed.

tasks.name: Deploy portal to Azure App Service production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Code deployed to production; database migrations applied; environment variables configured; SSL certificate installed; monitoring and alerting enabled.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke test script covers: login, checklist view, document upload, account provisioning, HR dashboard; all tests pass; no critical issues found.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from stakeholders and activate support
tasks.definition_of_done: Signed go-live approval from CEO, HR Director, IT Director; support team briefed; escalation contacts confirmed; launch email sent to all new hires.
